selected_script.angle: A dirty shoe-print dragged across entryway tile grout turns into muddy streaks when rubbed with a damp rag instead of actually lifting from the grout line
selected_script.hook: I tried wiping this muddy grout line with a damp rag, and it just spread the dirt farther down the crack.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up on an entryway ceramic tile floor grout line with muddy shoe-print dirt packed into the groove; a hand uses a damp household rag to wipe across it, but the mud visibly smears over the tile edges and the grout stays dark.
timeline.3-6s: The same rag keeps rubbing the same line with more pressure, leaving wet gray streaks, lint, and dirty residue while the hand pauses in frustration; the stain looks spread out instead of removed.
timeline.6-10s: The Grout Cleaner Kit with Stand-Up Brush enters naturally beside the same stain; cleaner is applied to the dirty grout, the bright blue V-shaped brush with white bristles scrubs along the line while attached to a standard pole, then the area is wiped to reveal a visibly cleaner grout strip next to the untouched muddy section; end with a quick handheld before-after tilt and a light spoken CTA: Check it out for cleaner grout without kneeling.

scenes.promptText: Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style, natural home lighting, no polished studio look. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity for the Grout Cleaner Kit with Stand-Up Brush: preserve the white 32 oz Grout-eez cleaner bottle, red and blue front label with Clean-eez logo position, ribbed white bottle neck, white cap, smooth plastic bottle body, glossy printed label, bright blue wide V-shaped grout brush head, angled blue threaded socket, dense white twisted nylon bristles, thick plastic material, shape, proportions, color, texture, and visible structure. Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, packaging, label, or brush structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, attachments, packaging, or exaggerated functions; a plain standard threaded pole may be attached because the brush is designed for it, but do not feature any branded or invented pole design. Timeline: 0-3s: extreme close-up on a real entryway ceramic or porcelain tile floor grout line with muddy shoe-print dirt packed into the groove. A hand tries the familiar ordinary method: wiping with a damp household rag. The rag drags over the grout and visibly smears brown-gray mud onto the tile edges while the grout line remains dark. Do not start with a product shot. 3-6s: continue the same failed rag method on the same stain. The hand rubs harder back and forth, creating more wet gray streaks, lint, residue, and a wider dirty haze on the tile surface; show believable effort and a brief frustrated pause, but keep it realistic and not comedic. 6-10s: the Grout Cleaner Kit enters naturally into the same frame beside the exact same muddy grout line. Show the real cleaning action: a small amount of cleaner is applied to the dirty grout, then the bright blue V-shaped brush with white bristles scrubs directly along the grout groove with practical pressure while standing with the pole angled into frame. No magical instant cleanup; show the bristles loosening dirt and the dirty liquid being wiped away. Finish with credible result proof: a handheld tilt or split-in-frame comparison of the cleaned lighter grout strip beside an untouched dark muddy section on the same tile floor, plus the bottle and brush visible nearby. End with a light natural spoken CTA only: 'Check it out for cleaner grout without kneeling.' No UI, no subtitles, no stickers, no text overlays, no captions, no watermarks, no poster graphics, no floating labels, no invented accessories, no product drift, no magical cleanup, no smoke, no fizzing, no glowing, no exaggerated chemical effects. Keep the product central and consistent, safe-looking for ceramic or porcelain tile, and make the before-after contrast believable.
